mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and may inhibit CYP2E1, potentially increasing acetaminophen metabolism and risk of hepatotoxic metabolite formation, particularly with high doses or in patients with hepatic impairment.
action: Monitor for signs of hepatotoxicity; use acetaminophen at lowest effective dose and avoid exceeding 3-4g daily; counsel patients on alcohol avoidance during concurrent use.
